rem Coresilience
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=245
rem C(n) = (n - phi(n)) / (n - 1). Add
rem up the composite n up to Limit for
rem which C(n) is a unit fraction 1 / k

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 200000000000

rem Then n - 1 = k (n - phi(n)), so n is
rem squarefree with all primes above k,
rem and n = pq gives (p - k) (q - k) =
rem k^2 - k + 1. Those divisors come
rem from the factors of k^2 - k + 1
rem found by a sieve of its roots mod
rem each prime r, the roots being -w for
rem the cube roots of unity w. With
rem three or more primes, k is below the
rem cube root of Limit and the primes
rem are chosen from the least up, with m
rem their product and A = phi(m). The
rem last prime is then p = (k A + 1) /
rem (k A - (k - 1) m). The next prime q
rem must have q / (q - 1) below k A / (k
rem A - (k - 1) m), and the product of
rem the ratios of the primes that still
rem fit must reach it.
Rt = Limit isqrt + 1
Pr = primes till (Rt + 1) array
Np = Pr len
Pi = array shape (Rt + 2) fill 0
for I in 0 till Np
  Pi (Pr I) = 1
end
Pi = Pi scan + with 0
Kk = Rt
Rs = array shape (Kk + 1) fill 0
for K in 2 to Kk
  Rs K = K * K - K + 1
end
Nf = array shape (Kk + 1) fill 0
Fp = array shape (12 * (Kk + 1)) fill 0
Fe = array shape (12 * (Kk + 1)) fill 0
for R in Pr
  if R equal 2
    continue
  end
  Roots = array 0 0
  Nr = 1
  if R mod 3 equal 1
    for G in 2 to R
      W = 1
      B = G
      E = (R - 1) // 3
      for
        if E equal 0
          break
        end
        if E mod 2 equal 1
          W = W * B mod R
        end
        B = B * B mod R
        E = E // 2
      end
      if W greater 1
        Roots 0 = R - W
        Roots 1 = R - W * W mod R
        Nr = 2
        break
      end
    end
  else
    if R equal 3
      Roots 0 = 2
    else
      Nr = 0
    end
  end
  for J in 0 till Nr
    X = Roots J
    Fk = 2 + (X - 2) mod R
    for K in Fk to Kk by R
      Ex = 0
      for
        if Rs K mod R greater 0
          break
        end
        Rs K = Rs K // R
        Ex += 1
      end
      Slot = K * 12 + Nf K
      Fp Slot = R
      Fe Slot = Ex
      Nf K += 1
    end
  end
end
Dv = array shape 5000 fill 0
Total = 0
for K in 2 to Kk
  Nd = 1
  Dv 0 = 1
  Cf = Nf K
  for J in 0 till Cf
    Slot = K * 12 + J
    Pw = 1
    Old = Nd
    for E in 1 to (Fe Slot)
      Pw = Pw * Fp Slot
      for L in 0 till Old
        Dv Nd = Dv L * Pw
        Nd += 1
      end
    end
  end
  if Rs K greater 1
    Old = Nd
    for L in 0 till Old
      Dv Nd = Dv L * Rs K
      Nd += 1
    end
  end
  Kq = K * K - K + 1
  for L in 0 till Nd
    A = Dv L
    B = Kq // A
    if A less B
      P = K + A
      Q = K + B
      if P * Q at most Limit
        if P in primes and Q in primes
          Total += P * Q
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
Ms = array shape 20 fill 0
As = array shape 20 fill 0
Lp = array shape 20 fill 0
Ci = array shape 20 fill 0
Cm = array shape 100000 fill 0
Cp = array shape 100000 fill 0
Nc = 0
Kc = 2
for
  if Kc * Kc * Kc greater Limit
    break
  end
  Kc += 1
end
for K in 2 to Kc
  D = 0
  Ms 0 = 1
  As 0 = 1
  Lp 0 = 1
  Fresh = 1
  for
    M = Ms D
    A = As D
    if Fresh equal 1
      Fresh = 0
      Kb = K * A
      Dd = Kb - (K - 1) * M
      Ci D = Np
      if Dd greater 0
        if (Kb + 1) mod Dd equal 0
          P = (Kb + 1) // Dd
          if P greater Lp D
            if M * P at most Limit
              if D at least 2
                Cm Nc = M
                Cp Nc = P
                Nc += 1
              end
            end
          end
        end
        Lb = K
        if Lp D greater Lb
          Lb = Lp D
        end
        if Kb // Dd greater Lb
          Lb = Kb // Dd
        end
        if Lb less Rt
          Ci D = Pi (Lb + 1)
        end
      end
    end
    Up = 0
    Q = 0
    if Ci D at least Np
      Up = 1
    else
      Q = Pr (Ci D)
      Ci D += 1
      if M * Q * Q greater Limit
        Up = 1
      end
    end
    if Up equal 0 and D equal 0
      if Q * Q * Q greater Limit
        Up = 1
      end
    end
    if Up equal 0
      Cn = 0
      Mm = M
      Lhs = (K - 1) * M
      Rhs = K * A
      for
        if Mm * Q greater Limit
          break
        end
        Mm = Mm * Q
        Lhs = Lhs * Q
        Rhs = Rhs * (Q - 1)
      end
      if Lhs less Rhs
        Up = 1
      end
    end
    if Up equal 1
      if D equal 0
        break
      end
      D -= 1
    else
      Ms (D + 1) = M * Q
      As (D + 1) = A * (Q - 1)
      Lp (D + 1) = Q
      D += 1
      Fresh = 1
    end
  end
end
for I in 0 till Nc
  if Cp I in primes
    Total += Cm I * Cp I
  end
end
Answer = Total
Answer print
